derivation:
by
  apply Subtype.ext; apply Units.ext
  rw [← IsDiag.diagonal_diag g.2, ← IsDiag.diagonal_diag h.2]; simp only [diag, heq]
explanation: Mathlib reconstructs any diagonal matrix from its diagonal entries. Apply this to both underlying matrices, then use heq; subtype and unit extensionality lift the resulting equality.
